name: Tequila Sunrise
description: Blanco tequila and orange juice with a grenadine float that settles into a sunrise gradient.
history: Popularized in the 1970s California bar scene—built tall, never shaken hard once the grenadine goes in.
whyItWorks: Orange juice brightens agave; grenadine sinks for color and a soft pomegranate finish.
steps: Fill a highball with ice and add tequila.
Top with orange juice and stir once to chill.
Pour grenadine slowly down the inside of the glass so it settles at the bottom.
Garnish with orange and a cherry; do not stir the finished sunrise.
techniqueNotes: Pour grenadine last and leave the gradient intact.
Fresh orange juice drinks brighter than carton concentrate.

recommendedBottles.rationale: Clean cristalino profile under orange juice.

substitutions.notes: Añejo makes a richer, oakier sunrise.

variations.name: Tequila Sunset
variations.notes: Add a touch of blackberry or cherry liqueur with the grenadine.
